paragraph: Today's Granville composite reading sits right at a neutral 50 out of 100 with no active breadth divergence warnings, reflecting a market caught in a sharp internal tug-of-war. While underlying strength shines through via outperforming equal-weight breadth at +0.92% and a surging transport sector up +2.28%, aggressive risk-off behavior is flashing red through a severe -3.58% collapse in high-beta versus low-volatility names and a -3.57% drubbing in bellwether semis. This cross-current is further muddled by defensive rotation favoring staples over discretionary by +1.82% while the VIX hovers at an elevated 22.91 amid normal contango and a rising 10-year real yield of 2.91%. With credit spreads holding stable at 3.23% and the dollar anchored, the structural plumbing remains intact despite heavy tech and risk liquidation. Expect a choppy, highly rotational session with a slight defensive bias until the aggressive tech selling exhausts itself.
